title: GroupMobility._update_jitter redraw loop hangs on giant dt with tiny jitter_update_us
description: Found in 3x codereview of uory fix (mobility.py ~:398). _update_jitter's 'while self._jitter_elapsed_us >= self.jitter_update_us' loop is NOT covered by the step() iteration cap: with jitter_m>0, jitter_update_us=1, dt_us=10**18 it performs ~dt/jitter_update_us redraw iterations (RNG+trig per member per pass) - the exact hang class uory fixed for the movement loops. Fix: cap redraws per call (or compute redraw count arithmetically: elapsed = (elapsed + dt) % jitter_update_us, redraws = total // jitter_update_us, drawing only the last few targets that matter). Test: jitter_m>0 + jitter_update_us=1 + giant dt terminates (giant-dt test file test_mobility_giant_dt.py currently only covers jitter_m=0).
acceptance_criteria: giant-dt regression test with jitter_m>0/jitter_update_us=1 passes; no other behavior change for normal configs
close_reason: Fixed: _update_jitter redraw loop now capped at _MAX_STEP_ITERATIONS per step() call (same bounded-work policy as the movement loops); elapsed zeroed on break. Behavior identical for all configs drawing <= 100k target sets; giant-dt configs bounded (~100k redraws). New regression test test_group_mobility_giant_dt_tiny_jitter_update_terminates. Suite 1645 passed, mypy+ruff clean.
